name: Simpli.fi
shortInfo: Simply.fi is a programmatic advertising and marketing platform.
brief: Simpli.fi offers programmatic advertising and workflow software to agencies, brands, and media companies.
about: DataChannel’s Simply.fi Connector lets you sync data from the Simply.fi API automatically into your data warehouse. To access campaign data use this connector and track various metrics to aid in campaign management.
availableData:
[Campaign Stats](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/simplifi/pipelines/campaign-stats.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all the statistics of the campaigns you’ve created.

[Campaigns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/simplifi/pipelines/campaigns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of all the campaigns you’ve created.

[Webhook Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/simplifi/pipelines/webhook-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a previously configured report.
